subject: Re: Aligning calendars for product micro-demo and tech deep-dive
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@finlytics.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Aligning calendars for product micro-demo and tech deep-dive

Hi Sam — great conversation today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next step:

- Recap: You’re evaluating ways to reduce per-inference cost and tighten 95th-percentile latency for FinLytics’ inference pipeline. Key stakeholders: Maya (data platform), and an internal infra lead who may join the technical deep-dive.
- Recommended next step: 20-minute micro-demo (product fit) + 45-minute technical deep-dive (optional follow-up) where we bring a solutions engineer.

Can you pick one of these windows for the 20-minute micro-demo next week? If none work, propose two that do and we’ll lock in immediately:

  • Mon, Feb 28: 11:00–11:20 PST or 15:00–15:20 PST
  • Tue, Mar 1: 09:30–09:50 PST

I’ve attached a short agenda (redwood-micro-demo-agenda.pdf) and a draft mutual action plan (mutual_action_plan.xlsx) so you can share with stakeholders. If one of the above works, reply with a quick “yes — 15:00 PST” and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to taking the next step.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai

[Attachment: redwood-micro-demo-agenda.pdf (1 page)]

From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@finlytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Rao <maya.rao@finlytics.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 10:43:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Aligning calendars for product micro-demo and tech deep-dive

Hi Karthik — thanks for the recap and the materials. I shared the agenda with Maya and our infra lead. I booked Mon, Feb 28 at 15:00 PST via your Calendly link.

Heads up: our infra lead might need to hop off early — we can still do the 20-minute micro-demo and then follow with the 45-minute technical session later if needed. If that sounds okay to you, please confirm and include your SE on the invite.

Appreciate it,
Sam
Sam Patel
Head of ML Platform
FinLytics
sam.patel@finlytics.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@finlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Feb 2027 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning calendars for product micro-demo and tech deep-dive

Sam — I was on the call at 15:00 PST but it looks like we missed you and Maya. No problem — these things happen. Quick options to get back on track: please reply with just the letter of whichever you can commit to in the next 48 hours so we can lock the calendar.

A) Mon, Feb 28 — 16:00–16:20 PST (today, in 55 minutes)
B) Tue, Mar 1 — 09:30–09:50 PST
C) Tue, Mar 1 — 15:00–15:20 PST

If none work, send two windows and we’ll prioritize matching them. I’ll have our solutions engineer (Lauren) on the invite for the technical follow-up. To keep this light, the micro-demo will be 20 minutes and we’ll record it if needed.

Also attaching my availability as an .ics in case that helps (karthik-availability.ics). Please reply with the single-letter choice so we can confirm quickly.

Best,
Karthik
(On behalf of Redwood Inference)

[Attachment: karthik-availability.ics]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@finlytics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Feb 2027 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning calendars for product micro-demo and tech deep-dive

Hi Sam — quick follow from the SE side. If you can confirm choice A/B/C (one quick word), I’ll send the invite that includes the micro-demo agenda and a tentative calendar hold for the technical deep-dive (45m). We prefer a one-word confirmation so the invite goes out immediately and we don’t lose the timeframe.

Also: would you like the recording shared afterward and a short MLP cost estimate for the example workload you mentioned? We can include that in the mutual action plan.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.ai

[Attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx]
